results.name: source import replaces structure and preserves nested hierarchy
dragging the title overlay moves its whole zone once and undo restores it
invalid drafts preserve diagram and history, and typing never relayouts
adding and editing a node preserves ID and updates generated source
shape labels fit measured text, including long and wide glyphs
parent membership, grouping and ungrouping preserve objects
multi-selection alignment, distribution and grid nudges are undoable
zone creation, resizing, naming and deletion retain contents and title bounds
edge properties, endpoints, loops and parallel connections update without relayout
source application retains manual centres and unsupported imports do not replace the diagram
layout preferences and draft edits preserve positions; explicit layout is undoable
cancelled node drag restores model and creates no history entry
save/open restores exact geometry and settings without relayout
SVG, PNG and Mermaid exports use the current model and exclude handles
deleting nodes removes incident edges in one undoable action
dragging handles creates parallel edges and self-loops, then reconnects an endpoint
parallel edge attachments and reconnect handles remain separate after moving and reshaping nodes
pending node, edge, and zone labels commit before canvas actions and saving
New clears the canvas and source draft as one undoable action
new objects inherit the innermost containing zone and move with it
fresh source fits the viewport while edits to existing IDs preserve the view
the dot grid follows world coordinates at different zooms and after panning
all loaded runtime resources are local; external access is blocked by policy
